title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return the indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. You may assume that each input has exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice. Return the answer in any order.
hint: As you iterate, store each number and its index in a Map. Look up target minus the current number.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string s containing only the characters (, ), {, }, [ and ], determine if the input string is valid. Opening brackets must be closed by the same type of brackets, in the correct order.
constraints: s consists only of bracket characters.
hint: Use a stack to track the expected closing bracket for every opening bracket.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters. A substring is a contiguous sequence of characters within a string.
constraints: s consists of English letters, digits, symbols and spaces.
hint: Maintain a sliding window containing unique characters, moving its left edge when you find a duplicate.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array of integers nums and a target, return the index of target if it exists. Otherwise return -1. Your algorithm must run in O(log n) time.
constraints: All integers in nums are unique and sorted in ascending order.
hint: Compare the middle element with target, then discard the half that cannot contain it.

title: Maximum Subarray
description: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum, and return that sum. A subarray must contain at least one number.
hint: At each position, decide whether to extend the current subarray or start a new one.

title: Merge Intervals
description: Given an array of intervals where each interval is [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals. Return an array of the non-overlapping intervals sorted by their start value.
hint: Sort by starting position. Compare each interval with the last merged interval.

title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.
hint: The water above a bar is bounded by the smaller of the tallest walls on either side.

title: Climbing Stairs
description: You are climbing a staircase with n steps. Each time you can climb 1 or 2 steps. How many distinct ways can you climb to the top?
hint: To reach step n, you must come from step n−1 or step n−2.

title: Valid Anagram
description: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise. An anagram contains exactly the same letters with the same frequencies.
constraints: s and t contain only lowercase English letters.
hint: Count how many times each character appears in both strings and compare the counts.
